name: prisant-powertools
description: General-purpose agent skills for the work around the work: session continuity, structured analysis, guide authoring, cross-LLM peer review, repository auditing, resolving open questions and decisions, status snapshots, and the specification and release-planning documents that sit between an idea and a tag. Use when wrapping or resuming a coding session, turning raw thinking into a decision-ready brief, generating a guide bundle, getting a second-model review of a document, auditing a repository, walking through the questions and decisions a session left open, writing a status snapshot of a repository, writing a feature spec, managing a version-scoped release plan, or scaffolding agent infrastructure into a repository.
